selection_rationale: Gradient Boosting was selected using 5-fold cross-validated ROC-AUC on the training split only (0.826 ± 0.004); the test set was kept for final reporting. ROC-AUC measures ranking quality independently of any threshold, unlike accuracy. Where models were within 0.001 AUC, the simpler model was preferred. At the 0.5 threshold it reaches recall 0.705 and precision 0.773, with 2,034 false negatives and 1,426 false positives out of 13,785 test records.
